# Open Economics

Open Economics is a free, public, read-only API and MCP server for official Brazilian economic and financial data. It requires no account or API key and supports browser CORS, JSON, CSV, OpenAPI 3.1, and Streamable HTTP MCP.

Base URL: https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/api/v1
Semantic API: https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/api/v2
Remote MCP: https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/api/mcp
Ask the data: https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/en/ask
MCP setup: https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/en/mcp
Documentation: https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/en/docs
Portuguese documentation: https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/pt-br/docs
OpenAPI 3.1 v2: https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/api/v2/openapi.json
OpenAPI 3.1 v1: https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/api/v1/openapi.json
Indicator catalog: https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/api/v1/indicators

## Core tasks

- Resolve a natural-language need: GET /api/v2/search?q=desemprego%20desde%202015
- Inspect dataset semantics: GET /api/v2/datasets/ibge-aggregates%3A6381/schema
- Query an official dataset: GET /api/v2/datasets/{id}/observations
- Search stable indicators: GET /api/v1/indicators?q=ipca
- Read indicator metadata: GET /api/v1/indicators/br-ipca-monthly
- Fetch history: GET /api/v1/indicators/br-ipca-monthly/observations?start=2020-01-01&order=asc
- Fetch latest value: GET /api/v1/indicators/br-selic-target/latest
- Download CSV: add format=csv to an observations request
- Connect an agent: use https://open-economics-data.knbf982hkn.chatgpt.site/api/mcp as a remote MCP server

## MCP workflow

The server exposes 19 read-only tools. Start with search_official_data when the exact official dataset is unknown. Inspect the matching provider schema before querying multidimensional data. Preserve units, periods, dimensions, official IDs, raw values, source URLs, and retrieval timestamps in answers.

Core tools include search_official_data, describe_official_dataset, get_bcb_series, get_bcb_schema, get_ibge_schema, get_ibge_data, get_siconfi_data, get_comexstat, get_anp_fuel_prices, get_epe_electricity, get_mte_formal_employment, get_cvm_investment_funds, get_tesouro_rtn, and get_tesouro_dpf.

## Important series

- br-ipca-monthly — IPCA monthly change, IBGE
- br-ipca-12m — IPCA trailing 12-month change, IBGE
- br-selic-target — Copom Selic target, BCB
- br-selic-monthly — Selic accumulated in the month, BCB
- br-usd-brl — official daily USD/BRL selling exchange rate, BCB
- br-unemployment-rate — national unemployment rate, IBGE PNAD Contínua
- br-ibc-br — BCB monthly economic activity index

Responses preserve stable series IDs, frequency, units, official source IDs and URLs, raw published values, normalized dates, retrieval timestamps, license information, and upstream provenance. Values are never fabricated or silently forward-filled.
